title: Trust Story Selector
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Challenger Selling
description: Learners match four buyer trust concerns to the trust story type that answers each: credibility, authority, vulnerability, or authenticity.

learningObjectives: Select the appropriate trust story type (Credibility, Authority, Vulnerability, Authenticity) for different customer trust concerns.
prerequisites: Story Trust Building, Credibility Stories, and Authority Stories sections of Chapter 11

keyQuestions: Select the appropriate trust story type (Credibility, Authority, Vulnerability, Authenticity) for different customer trust concerns.
commonMisconceptions: All trust stories are the same.
assessmentOpportunities: Correct story type for all four concerns.
Learner can explain why a vulnerability story can build more trust than an authority story.
